title: Residents warned of possible Russian mining of area in Kherson
summary: Russian forces may have mined an area of Kherson. Explosive devices may have been placed on Ivana Vazova Street.

title: Russian attacks hit energy facilities in Cherkasy region, causing power outages
summary: Part of the population in the Cherkasy region has been left without electricity following a Russian attack on energy facilities.

title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,560 over past day
summary: Russia’s total combat losses in its full-scale invasion of Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 16, 2026, amount to approximately 1,625,420 personnel, including 2,560 over the past 24 hours.

title: Europe to engage in Ukraine peace talks and ensure maximum pressure on Russia – von der Leyen
summary: Europe will closely engage in negotiations on Ukraine through the E5 + EU format and ensure maximum pressure on Russia.

title: Paris commemorates victims of Holodomor and Russian aggression
summary: On November 15, Paris commemorated the victims of the 1932–1933 Holodomor and those killed as a result of Russia’s ongoing aggression against Ukraine. Wreaths were laid at the Arc de Triomphe, and a liturgy for the Ukrainian people was held at the Cathedral of Saint-Louis des Invalides.

title: Ukraine disables over 55% of Russia’s oil refining capacity – Zelensky
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces have disabled more than 55% of Russia’s oil refining capacity in response to Moscow’s refusal to de-escalate.

title: Russian attack hits critical industrial facility in Vinnytsia region
summary: A Russian attack on the Vinnytsia region struck a critical industrial facility. Efforts to deal with the aftermath have been complicated by the threat of further strikes.

title: Ukraine and EU preparing winter emergency support package – PM Koretskyi
summary: Ukraine and the European Union are preparing a package of emergency winter assistance to help effectively counter Russian terror in cities and regions.

title: Ukrainian women's Épée team wins bronze at fencing world cup in China
summary: The Women's Épée World Cup has concluded in the Chinese city of Wuxi.

title: Eight people detained in Estonia over attempted arson attack on defense industry plant allegedly commissioned by Russia
summary: The Estonian Prosecutor General’s Office said that an attempt was made to set fire to a building belonging to the defense industry company Threod in Viimsi on the night of Saturday, November 14.

title: Prince Harry attends All-Ukrainian Invictus Games in Lviv
summary: Prince Harry attended the All-Ukrainian Invictus Games in Lviv and personally showed his support for Ukraine’s defenders.

title: Ukrainian athlete and servicewoman Rayana killed in action
summary: Rayana, a Muay Thai coach and drone operator with the Sheikh Mansur Chechen Volunteer Battalion, has been killed in the war.

title: Ukrainians in Kuwait join Empty Chairs campaign
summary: Ukrainians in Kuwait have joined the global Empty Chairs campaign, which aims to draw the international community's attention to Russia's unlawful imprisonment of Ukrainian journalists, writers and human rights defenders.
